reason: 27 public-lineage repositories retain intentional shallow boundaries. A bundle verified inside its source repository can depend on shallow prerequisite objects and fail when fetched into an empty repository.

first_reproduced_failure.operation: fetch bundle into an empty independent repository
first_reproduced_failure.error_class: bundle did not send all necessary objects

replacement: transport schema 2.0.0 archives each complete path-safe .git metadata directory, including the shallow marker, and reconstructs the worktree with repository-local core.longpaths=true
upload_disposition: Rejected bundles and their obsolete index are excluded from the private wrapper and are not uploaded.
